text: Age is a prohibited ground of discrimination under the Canadian Human Rights Act.
Pregnancy discrimination under the Canadian Human Rights Act is deemed to be discrimination on the ground of sex.
Language is a prohibited ground of discrimination under the Canadian Human Rights Act.
The Canadian Human Rights Act applies only to federally regulated employers and service providers.
Under the Canadian Human Rights Act, it is a discriminatory practice to publish a job advertisement that implies a preference based on a prohibited ground of discrimination.
Citizenship is a prohibited ground of discrimination under the Canadian Human Rights Act.
Colour is a prohibited ground of discrimination under the Canadian Human Rights Act.
The Canadian Human Rights Act requires all complaints to be filed directly with the Federal Court of Canada.
